title: Ceramic Vessel of Betrayal
description: A large cracked white ceramic vase features a green dog head on the left and a woman's face with closed eyes on the right, both bleeding red from the eyes and mouth. A green snake coils around the top rim while red liquid drips down the vase onto a purple cloth below, surrounded by torn papers and glowing cracks.
prompt: Surreal painting of a large cracked porcelain vase with glowing golden repairs. On the left side is a green dog's head with sad eyes, on the right is a woman's serene face with closed eyes and red lips. Both are dripping thick red blood from their eyes and mouths. A vibrant green snake coils around the golden rim. The vase sits on a dark purple cloth with torn papers and red ribbons. Dramatic lighting with hanging blue lanterns in a dark decaying room with cracked walls.
